title: SCA Minhag of the Week 153: "Tefilla BeSibbur: Shabbat Musaf Customs"
summary: Mr. Harari discusses the minhagim for the Hazarah of Shabbat Musaf and the conclusion of the prayer. He explains the customs regarding the Keter, the Kohanim, and the sequence of prayers following the Kaddish Titkabal.
questions: Are there unique Halabi customs for the Musaf Hazarah?
Who sings the Keter during Musaf?
Is it required to have a different Hazzan for the Ketoret?
Do we say a Mizmor after Aleinu LeShabeach?
